title: The Last Vintage
tagline: Kent, October. Harvest night, and the lane is under water.
intro: Marchant Vineyard. A flash flood washed out the bridge on the lane, and nobody can get in or out. At 11:40 pm Ambrose Marchant, the owner of the vineyard, is found dead in the tasting cellar. One of the four people left here did it.
public_facts: A flash flood washed out the bridge on the lane at about 9:00 pm. Nobody could come or go after that.
The harvest supper ended at about 10:30 pm.
Ambrose Marchant, 68, the owner of the vineyard, went to the tasting cellar at about 10:45 pm.
Ambrose Marchant was found dead in the tasting cellar at 11:40 pm by Vivian Marchant. He had been struck on the head.
The people here that night were: Olivia Trent (a visitor), Vivian Marchant (Ambrose's brother), Hannah Rudd (cellar hand), Colin Dray (sales manager).

solution.motive: Colin Dray had been relabelling cheap wine as our best vintage and pocketing the difference. Ambrose opened a bottle of the best vintage and tasted cheap wine and was going to call the police in the morning.
solution.method: At about 11:05 pm Colin Dray went to the tasting cellar and argued with Ambrose, then struck him with a heavy glass decanter. He took the box of forged labels to the press house and tipped it into the grape crusher.

motives.text: Revenge for something Ambrose did that day
To get control of Marchant Vineyard
To stop Ambrose exposing something they had done

evidence.name: Sales office order book
evidence.description: Colin Dray's order book from the sales office. The last entry is timed 10:40 pm. The job is not finished.

evidence.name: Signed sale note
evidence.description: A signed note promising a quarter share of the vineyard to cover a debt. It puts Vivian Marchant in the farm kitchen from 11:00 pm to 11:22 pm.

evidence.name: Pulped labels
evidence.description: What is left of the box of forged labels, found in the press house. Parts of it can still be read.

evidence.name: Colin's shirt
evidence.description: Colin Dray's shirt, left in the wash room. There is grape juice on it.

evidence.name: Written warning
evidence.description: A written warning accusing the cellar hand of stealing bottles. It is dated today and names Hannah Rudd.

evidence.name: Housing company plan
evidence.description: A plan from a housing company showing the vineyard covered in new streets. It names Olivia Trent.

olivia_trent.name: Olivia Trent
olivia_trent.role: A visitor. Says they are a wine tourist. She arrived a few days ago.
story_they_tell: I am a wine tourist. I am here to see a harvest for myself.
After the harvest supper I stayed with the others until about 11:05 pm, then I went to my own quarters.
I was in my quarters when I heard the scream at 11:40 pm, and I came out.
shares_freely: At about 11:05 pm, on my way to my quarters, I passed the tasting cellar and heard two people arguing inside. One was Ambrose, and he was the loud one. The other voice was low and controlled. I could not tell who it was.
I heard Ambrose say something like 'two years' and 'in the morning'.
Ambrose and Vivian Marchant did not seem to get on.
olivia_trent.under_pressure: Stay charming and a little amused. Repeat your account. Remark that Ambrose and Vivian Marchant did not seem to get on.

stages.label: Exposed
admits: I am not a wine tourist. I am a land agent for a housing company, and I want to buy the vineyard for building land.
Two days ago I told Ambrose what I wanted, and he refused angrily and told me to leave. I stayed on anyway.
From what I have seen this week, something is badly wrong with how this place is run, and I think Ambrose had just found out.

hidden_truth.secret: Is really a land agent for a housing company and wants to buy the vineyard for building land.
what_really_happened: 11:05 pm: passed the tasting cellar and heard the argument, then went to their quarters.
giveaway_phrases: a land agent for a housing company
buy the vineyard for building land

vivian_marchant.name: Vivian Marchant
vivian_marchant.role: Ambrose Marchant's brother. He owns a quarter of the vineyard and does little of the work.
story_they_tell: After the harvest supper I was asleep in the guest room.
Later I went to look for Ambrose. I found Ambrose dead in the tasting cellar at 11:40 pm and I screamed.
Colin Dray was the first to reach me, within a minute.
Everything was perfectly fine between me and Ambrose.
shares_freely: Ambrose had been shut in the tasting cellar every evening this week, in a foul mood.
This afternoon I heard Ambrose shouting at Hannah Rudd. I do not know what it was about.
vivian_marchant.under_pressure: Go cold and formal. Repeat your account. Say you cannot believe anyone here would do this.

stages.label: Shaken
admits: I was not asleep in the guest room. From 11:00 pm to about 11:22 pm I was in the farm kitchen, signing away my share of the vineyard to a moneylender.
I owed money that I could not pay, and my brother did not know. I lied because it makes me look guilty.
At 11:40 pm I went to the tasting cellar and found Ambrose dead.
When Colin Dray reached me, he was not wearing his shirt, which is unusual.

hidden_truth.secret: Was in the farm kitchen, signing away my share of the vineyard to a moneylender. I owed money that I could not pay, and my brother did not know.
what_really_happened: 11:00 pm to 11:22 pm: in the farm kitchen, signing away my share of the vineyard to a moneylender.
giveaway_phrases: signing away my share of the vineyard to a moneylender
I owed money that I could not pay, and my brother did not know

hannah_rudd.name: Hannah Rudd
hannah_rudd.role: Cellar hand. She racks the barrels and runs the press.
story_they_tell: After the harvest supper I was in the barrel hall, topping up the barrels. I stayed there until I heard the scream at 11:40 pm.
I saw nobody after about 10:30 pm.
Things between me and Ambrose were fine, same as always.
shares_freely: Olivia Trent has been asking the people here odd questions.
Ambrose had been in a bad temper all week.
hannah_rudd.under_pressure: Get irritated and defensive. Repeat your account. Say the detective should look at Olivia Trent, who has been asking a lot of questions.

stages.label: Cornered
admits: Ambrose accused me this afternoon. I hid it because it makes me look guilty.
I was not in the barrel hall the whole time. From about 11:10 pm to 11:25 pm I was behind the barrel hall, sandbagging the door against the water.
At about 11:20 pm I saw Colin Dray coming out of the press house, with grape juice on his shirt. He did not see me.
The press house is nowhere near the sales office.

hidden_truth.secret: Ambrose accused them today, and they were behind the barrel hall at the time of the murder.
what_really_happened: 11:10 pm to 11:25 pm: behind the barrel hall, sandbagging the door against the water.
11:20 pm: saw Colin Dray leave the press house.
giveaway_phrases: sandbagging the door against the water

colin_dray.name: Colin Dray
colin_dray.role: Sales manager. He sells the wine and keeps the order book.
story_they_tell: After the harvest supper I went to the sales office. I was writing up the export orders.
I was in the sales office from about 10:30 pm until about 11:30 pm. I was alone and saw nobody.
I came when I heard the scream at 11:40 pm, and found Vivian Marchant at the door of the tasting cellar.
I did not go near the tasting cellar tonight until the scream.
I got on well with Ambrose. Nothing was wrong between us.
shares_freely: Ambrose told me this afternoon that he had accused Hannah Rudd, who took it badly.
Olivia Trent has asked a lot of questions about this place.
colin_dray.under_pressure: Stay calm and polite. Repeat your account. Suggest, as if reluctantly, that the detective should look at Hannah Rudd.

stages.label: Guarded
admits: The job was not finished. I stopped at about 10:40 pm and spent the rest of the time addressing shipping labels.
I still say I never left the sales office.

stages.label: Rattled
admits: I was not in the sales office the whole time. At about 11:10 pm I went to the press house, only to see that the crusher was switched off, and I got grape juice on my shirt there.
I did not mention it before because it did not seem important.
I know nothing about any box of forged labels, and I still say I never went to the tasting cellar.

stages.label: Broken
admits: I have been relabelling cheap wine as our best vintage and pocketing the difference for two years.
Ambrose opened a bottle of the best vintage and tasted cheap wine this afternoon and was going to call the police in the morning.
At about 11:05 pm I went to the tasting cellar to beg for more time. We argued, and at about 11:10 pm I struck Ambrose with a heavy glass decanter.
Then I took the box of forged labels to the press house and tipped it into the grape crusher. That is how I got grape juice on my shirt.

hidden_truth.secret: Killed Ambrose Marchant. Had been relabelling cheap wine as our best vintage and pocketing the difference.
what_really_happened: 11:05 pm: went to the tasting cellar and argued with Ambrose.
11:10 pm: struck Ambrose with a heavy glass decanter.
11:12 pm: took the box of forged labels to the press house and tipped it into the grape crusher.
11:20 pm: left the press house and was seen by Hannah Rudd.
giveaway_phrases: relabelling cheap wine as our best vintage and pocketing the difference
tipped it into the grape crusher
